findingDetails.issue: The docs table incorrectly says state/message matching is the only refusal source. tools/ask-model.mjs:1708 and :1715 also recognize inline and result-level denied_actions independently. Both cases returned exit 4 in replay without any failed state or error message. No code supports the exclusivity claim; the cited :1639 covers only agyRefusal.
findingDetails.quote: "claim": "Refusals are recognized from step state and error-message wording only; other errors such as not found do not fail the build",
findingDetails.suggestion: Limit the state/message statement to tool-step matching and name denied_actions as another refusal source.
findingDetails.trigger: A maintainer consults this evidence table when diagnosing a native build refused solely through inline or result-level denied_actions.
